text:
Asha: Hey team — onboarding POC with FinRegCo next week. They require all inference and KV cache to stay in EU (no US egress). Can we confirm feasible regions/sub-processors and any config we need to set for routing? Also need high-level cost delta for Dedicated vs hosted for this POC. cc @Jonas

Jonas: We can serve entirely from eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Subproc list: https://redwood.company/subprocessors — but note: some infra (telemetry/analytics) touches US for metrics unless disabled. Recommend Dedicated or Private for strict controls.

Priya: Security flag — need to confirm KMS location and whether key material ever leaves EU. If they require BYOK in their own KMS, Private deployment is recommended. Also: what's the required audit log retention?

Asha: Customer wants BYOK + 365d logs. Also they want canary failover within EU only. Is that possible without cross-region routing to the US?

Carlos: Yes — canary failover inside EU is doable. Ops note: Dedicated pools in eu-central are available but burst/baseline autoscale may reach shared-hosted pools which could touch US subproc for billing/telemetry. We can enforce strict routing to avoid that, but it affects availability behavior.

Jonas: Example routing policy we can apply on the account (can include in SOW):
```json
{
  "routing_policy": {
    "region_preference": ["eu-central-1", "eu-west-1"],
    "allow_fallback_to_hosted": false,
    "subprocessors_whitelist": ["eu-ops-logs", "eu-cdn"]
  }
}
```

Priya: If allow_fallback_to_hosted=false and BYOK is used, we should also disable telemetry export to external metrics (or ensure EU-only telemetry). That will reduce the out-of-the-box dashboard fidelity. Need formal signoff from customer.

Mei: Quick Q from the buyer — what's the monthly delta for Dedicated w/ EU-only routing vs hosted? We're planning ~50k requests/day for the POC.

Jonas: Rough calc: Dedicated reserved pool (small/medium) ~ €6,000/month commit for the qps and KV cache sizing we estimate. Hosted with EU pinning + bandwidth/egress considerations ~ €9,000/month for similar throughput (higher per-token at scale). I'll put a cleaner spreadsheet together. These numbers assume all KV/cache + inference traffic remains in EU.

Asha: Please attach subproc certificates and the routing policy we can include in the SOW. Also need turnaround time for Private eval (customer asked).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: POC tenant 'finregco-eu-poc' created in eu-central-1 (id: poc-2351).

Carlos: Ops ETA for Dedicated pool provisioning: ~3 business days after signed commitment. Private eval (VPC/on-prem package) usually takes 2–4 weeks depending on customer environment and compliance checks.

Priya: I'll draft a short security addendum covering BYOK, KMS residency, and audit retention. If they want an SCCE we can schedule one next week.

Asha: Thanks everyone :pray: I'll loop legal for SOW language and schedule a 30m sync with the customer tomorrow. @Jonas please drop the spreadsheet and the EU subproc cert bundle here when ready.
